description: In 1929, Tennessee farmer John W. Oliver refused to sell his 375-acre Cades Cove farm for $20 an acre, leading to a lengthy court battle over land wanted for Great Smoky Mountains National Park. After the Tennessee Supreme Court ruled against him, Oliver ultimately lost his property and received $17,000 in 1935.
title: Tennessee farmer refused $20 an acre for national park land

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Jana Nayagan's theatrical earnings saw another decline on its twentieth day. The film collected sixty-five lakhs in India, a slight drop from yesterday. Its total India net collection has now reached one hundred ninety-three point seven zero crores. Worldwide gross collections for the political drama stand at three hundred eighteen point eight three crores. Overseas collections have significantly contributed to the film's overall success.
title: Jana Nayagan box office day 20: Vijay's film nears Rs 194cr in India

author: TOI SPORTS DESK
description: The tour consists of three ODIs and three T20Is. It was originally scheduled for August last year but was postponed after relations between Dhaka and New Delhi deteriorated.
title: Bangladesh races to save India tour, says foreign ministers involved in talks
